decisions.reason: Having survived its first market test with a dedicated presentation and a strong fit to the firm's core space-camera business, it is likely performing at or near aspiration levels and is worth retaining.
This sensor suite builds closely on existing capabilities, was visibly promoted, and in a growing high-R&D firm with some slack management would continue it unless clearer shortfalls emerged.
A radiation-hard camera line with several models and its own page signals strategic commitment in a core application area, so boundedly rational management would give it time to establish itself.

Because the asteroid navigation camera is more niche and only lightly presented, its results are more uncertain and somewhat more at risk of falling below aspiration, but the firm's slack and strategic interest in future missions still favor keeping it for now.
